Themes & Desktop

Themes & Desktop apps for Omarchy

19 packages from the official Omarchy repository.

Reviewed 2026-10-17 · independent editorial guide

Short answer

Install any of these with omarchy pkg add <name>. The list below has all 19 themes & desktop packages in the official repo as of 2026-10-17.

Every themes & desktop package

Listed alphabetically. Categories are this site's own grouping; the packages and versions come from pkgs.omarchy.org.

  • aether omarchy pkg add aether
    Turn any wallpaper into a matching color scheme for your whole Linux desktop.
  • hyprland-preview-share-picker omarchy pkg add hyprland-preview-share-picker
    Pick exactly the window or monitor you're sharing, by actually seeing it first.
  • hyprland-preview-share-picker-git omarchy pkg add hyprland-preview-share-picker-git
    Pick exactly the window or monitor you're sharing, by actually seeing it first.
  • hyprshade omarchy pkg add hyprshade
    Automatic blue-light filtering and screen shaders for Hyprland, on a schedule.
  • omarchy-settings omarchy pkg add omarchy-settings
    The default look, fonts, and boot theme Omarchy ships with, in one system package.
  • omarchy-settings-dev omarchy pkg add omarchy-settings-dev
    The same Omarchy defaults package, built straight from the bleeding-edge quattro branch.
  • quickshell-git omarchy pkg add quickshell-git
    A QtQuick-based toolkit for coding your own Linux desktop shell from scratch.
  • ttf-ia-writer omarchy pkg add ttf-ia-writer
    The clean monospaced and duo-width fonts behind the iA Writer app, free to use on your own desktop.
  • ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic omarchy pkg add ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic
    JetBrains Mono, patched with thousands of extra icons for terminals and code editors.
  • walker omarchy pkg add walker
    One popup for apps, math, files, and more.
  • yaru-gnome-shell-theme omarchy pkg add yaru-gnome-shell-theme
    Ubuntu's signature look, for the GNOME Shell chrome around your desktop.
  • yaru-gtk-theme omarchy pkg add yaru-gtk-theme
    The GTK widget theme behind Ubuntu's familiar desktop look.
  • yaru-gtksourceview-theme omarchy pkg add yaru-gtksourceview-theme
    Ubuntu-matching syntax highlighting colors for GTK-based text and code views.
  • yaru-icon-theme omarchy pkg add yaru-icon-theme
    The colorful, rounded icon set that defines Ubuntu's visual identity.
  • yaru-metacity-theme omarchy pkg add yaru-metacity-theme
    Ubuntu-styled window borders and decorations for the Metacity window manager.
  • yaru-session omarchy pkg add yaru-session
    The glue package that wires Yaru up as a selectable desktop session.
  • yaru-sound-theme omarchy pkg add yaru-sound-theme
    The login, notification, and alert sounds that come with Ubuntu.
  • yaru-unity-theme omarchy pkg add yaru-unity-theme
    Yaru's styling for the Unity desktop's launcher and panel.
  • yaru-xfwm4-theme omarchy pkg add yaru-xfwm4-theme
    Ubuntu's Yaru look, brought to the Xfce window manager.
